info.name: Relay Backend - Lobby
info.description: WebSocket requests for creating, listing, and joining Relay multiplayer lobbies.

item.name: Lobby WebSocket
item.description:
Open a new Postman WebSocket request manually using this URL:

ws://{{host}}:{{port}}/multiplayer

Postman collections treat WebSocket entries as HTTP requests during import, so this item is documentation-only. After connecting, send the message payloads from the items below in the WebSocket message panel.

item.name: Create Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Do not send this HTTP template as a regular request.

item.name: List Rooms Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Do not send this HTTP template as a regular request.

item.name: Search Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel to find a lobby by code without joining it.

item.name: Join Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Use a roomId returned by list_rooms. Do not send this HTTP template as a regular request.

item.name: Delete Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Only the room owner can delete the lobby.

item.name: Join Room Via Code Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. This direct code join does not require list_rooms first. Do not send this HTTP template as a regular request.

item.name: Get Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Requires the sending connection to already be in a room (via create_room or join_room).

item.name: Get Players Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Requires the sending connection to already be in a room.

item.name: Set Ready Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Set ready to false to flip back to not_ready. Requires the sending connection to already be in a room.

item.name: Leave Room Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Requires the sending connection to already be in a room. Works in the lobby or while a game is in progress.

item.name: Manage Player (Kick) Message
item.description: Copy the Body JSON into the Postman WebSocket message panel. Only the current room owner can send this. Set targetPlayerId to a real player id returned by room_created/room_joined/players_list (owner cannot target themselves).
